'''Pertaal Shenvehr''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]], who worked for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Shenvehr worked on [[Findris]], as an [[Assistant Features Editor]] for [[Colonial News Nets|Colonial News Net]], a daily data publication. Shenvehr wrote various columns for the publication, including one titled "Ask Argothil Anything," in which he put encrypted messages for members of the Rebel Alliance. Alliance operatives would supply Shenvahr with information through questions on the [[Imperial NetPost]], which he would then write into his column, in a metaphoric form.<ref name="CRO" />

Shenvehr received his information through a friend that worked in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Sector Command]] on Findris. Shenvehr's messages were widely available to members of the Alliance, but [[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] considered them to be of little help, as they were difficult to interpret. Despite working for the same company he was unaware that [[Fionna Flannis]] was also a Rebel operative.<ref name="CRO" />

==Personality and traits==
Shenveehr was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was only 1.5 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall. He wore his beard a bit longer then what was considered fashionable and appeared to wear the same business tunic every day. He was not particularly outgoing and took his editorial work very seriously.<ref name="CRO" />

==Skills and abilities==
Shenveehr was a talented reporter who had considerable knowledge of the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]]. He was skilled at uncovering information, but he was not a field operative and did not have combat training.<ref name="CRO" />

==Equipment==
All Shenveehr carried with him was a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] and a [[recording rod]].<ref name="CRO" />

==Behind the scenes==
Pertaal Shenveehr was designed by [[Peter M. Schweighofer]] for ''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]'', a supplement for the ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' that was published by [[West End Games]] in [[1994]]. He was illustrated by [[Brian Schomburg]].
